title: Ceviche Peruano
description: Ceviche Peruano is a dish from Peru featuring sea bass, sweet potato, sweet corn, red onion. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used. Food-safety adaptation: fish is heat-cooked before dressing; traditional Peruvian ceviche commonly uses raw fish. Citrus alone is not a safety substitute.

steps.instruction: For this heat-cooked adaptation, cook fish to 63°C or fully opaque, then cool promptly before the lime dressing.
Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 22 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Wash and prepare the listed produce; dice or chop evenly for a consistent texture.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Refrigerate the prepared mixture for about 22 minutes, cooling perishable foods promptly and never holding cooked rice warm at room temperature.
Arrange the fully cooked and prepared parts of the dish on plates or in the intended serving vessel, adding the listed toppings or accompaniments just before serving.
